name: Crest
tagline: Two new looks, Zune and WinUI, and a design for every window size from a narrow phone-sized window to 4K.

highlights.title: Two new looks: Zune and WinUI
highlights.body: Zune brings back the Zune HD: big lowercase type, pivots across the top and colour washes from the cover that's playing. WinUI makes Wavee a Windows 11 app, with tabs in the title bar, a navigation pane and Windows controls. Both cover every page, in dark and light. Pick one in Settings > Appearance > Theme.

media.alt: Wavee in the Zune theme, with an album page in the WinUI theme in front of it

highlights.title: Made for every window size
highlights.body: Every page now has a layout for a narrow, phone-sized window, a medium one, the usual desktop size and very large screens up to 4K. Narrow windows get one column and buttons big enough to tap; large ones use the room for more columns and bigger covers. Resizing glides between layouts instead of jumping.

media.alt: Wavee's Home in a wide window and in a narrow, phone-sized window side by side

highlights.title: Lighter on memory
highlights.body: About 20 MB less graphics memory while you browse, and a peak about 12 % lower over a long session. On Snapdragon PCs the cover cache keeps to its size: up to 45 MB less after browsing many pages. A short pause after every page change is gone too.

media.alt: Wavee 0.3.6 against 0.3.5: about 20 MB less graphics memory while browsing, a 12 % lower peak, and up to 45 MB less for covers on Snapdragon PCs
